independent_replay.method: Independently select literal XML WORD strings in original paragraph/line order. Keep center x>=110 through full page width, center y>=340 on page1 or y>=280 otherwise, and y<=650 only on page 17. Exclude lower isolated numeric page labels. Join retained words/lines with spaces and paragraphs with blank LF, without supplying or replacing letters.

identity_findings.locus: Artifact page1, printed p. 221, translator paragraph
identity_findings.finding: The printed translation heading identifies Mgr. James H. Ryan, D.D., Ph.D., and N. C. W. C. News Service; both the translation notice and source title are retained by the mask.

identity_findings.locus: Artifact page1 translator notice and artifact page 15, printed p. 235 dating
identity_findings.finding: The notice says the encyclical was issued May 8, 1928; the actual printed closing says the ninth of May, 1928. This is a discrepancy in the historical English printing, not an OCR date error. Preserve both source assertions; canonical work metadata uses the actual act date 1928-05-08.
The papal signature is followed by the Prayer / Act of Reparation. Its final 58 XML words are the first six body lines of page 17, ending Amen. They must remain within the act-plus-prayer selection.

geometry_findings.finding: The corrected right boundary restores 133 substantive XML words previously clipped on even pages 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12, 16. Full-width inspection found these are main-column terminal words, not neighboring-page matter.

The initial 16-page extent stopped mid-prayer at Mother. Page17 XML line indices 2–7 are the missing 58-word continuation through Amen; their full boxes occupy y317–617. The next independent title begins at y735. The final y<=650 bound safely separates the complete prayer from the subsequent article.

All 17 source pages and the complete selected text were inspected. No further coordinate-induced removal of a substantive act word, heading, inline citation, signature or prayer word was observed. Excluded left strips contain neighboring-page bleed; upper strips are masthead/running heads; the final lower strip is the subsequent independent article.

rejected_history.reason: Word-center x<=1600 clipped 133 substantive right-edge XML words, and the prayer continuation on page 17 was absent.
Right-edge clipping repaired, but the selected extent still omitted the final 58 prayer words on page 17.

remaining_ocr_limitations: The XML itself does not recognize the large initial drop capitals: the act begins UR and the prayer WEET. The missing initial letters are not removed by the geometry mask and have not been supplied.
Word-recognition, punctuation, capitalization and printed line-hyphenation defects remain literal; this geometric admission does not certify clean verbatim transcription.
The full source issue has 20 pages; pages 18–20 belong to a different article and were not visually reviewed for this admission.
changes: No source file, extraction recipe, canonical record or typeset manifest was altered in this review lane. Only scratch review artifacts and an independent proposed selection were written.
